about: T-0178 calibration set: committed round runs, cited by round folder and run name under .sdlc/evals/rounds/. Good cases are runs that passed every probe check; bad cases are failed runs whose transcript visibly misses the named criterion. `npm run eval:judge -- selftest` scores each against its persona's rubric.
